title: Zero-Downtime Database Schema Migration on 500M Row Table
question: How should our engineering team plan and execute a non-blocking column split and index backfill on a 500-million row billing transactions table without downtime?
description: Evaluates expand-and-contract (parallel writing), shadow tables with trigger replication (gh-ost/pt-online-schema-change), and direct background indexing.
expectedConflict: Melchior models lock acquisition queues and replica lag during batch updates; Balthasar fears table-lock cascades locking out online payments; Casper outlines a 4-phase expand/contract release across two sprints.
keyTradeoffs: Zero-downtime safety through dual-writing vs double write load on database CPU
Shadow table replication tooling complexity vs standard native DDL lock risks
Multi-week gradual rollout duration vs immediate schema consolidation

title: Disaster Recovery: Multi-Cloud (AWS + GCP) vs Multi-Region Single Cloud
question: Should our critical financial service build a multi-cloud active disaster recovery environment across AWS and GCP or invest in multi-region redundancy strictly within AWS?
description: Evaluates protection against single-cloud provider catastrophic outages against massive cross-cloud egress costs, lowest-common-denominator tooling, and identity federation.
expectedConflict: Melchior models independent failure probabilities across cloud providers; Balthasar emphasizes the catastrophic surface area of cross-cloud IAM and networking sync; Casper recommends multi-region within one cloud with cold configuration escrow.
keyTradeoffs: Independence from single-cloud control plane outages vs cross-cloud network egress taxation
Unified multi-cloud Terraform abstractions vs leveraging deep native cloud provider integrations
Disaster recovery readiness parity vs maintaining two divergent production operational runbooks

title: Continuous Delivery: Transitioning from GitFlow to Continuous Deployment
question: What is the optimal roadmap for migrating an 80-engineer team from 2-week batch release cycles to multiple automated daily deployments to production?
description: Evaluates automated canary analysis, short-lived branch culture, automated integration tests, and executive risk appetite.

keyTradeoffs: Fast customer feedback loops and small diff sizes vs high initial investment in automated test automation
Eliminating merge debt vs the psychological barrier of releasing without manual QA signoff
Automated canary rollback detection vs transient false-positive rollback noise

title: Modernization: Strangler Fig Migration for Core 10-Year-Old Billing Engine

title: Analytics Modernization: Snowflake vs Databricks Lakehouse Migration
question: Should our enterprise data platform migrate its on-premise Hadoop cluster to Snowflake or a Databricks Lakehouse (Delta Lake / Iceberg)?

title: Edge Cutover: Global DNS and TLS Migration Between CDN Providers

title: Resilience Verification: Automated Fault Injection (Chaos Engineering) in Live Production
